The system operates under a dual constraint: local autonomy and AWS compliance. The manifest state M(t) evolves deterministically until external triggers (like budget cap B) force a transition into a future job dependency regime. The cost simulation kernel K(C) models potential expenses without real-time data, creating a bounded uncertainty region. Future job dependencies J are defined as a logical conjunction of R, P_l, P_w, B, O, which must all evaluate true for execution. Failure modes arise when M(t) lacks consistency with J, or when K(C) exceeds B. These primitives form a closed-loop system where GSE's state transitions are governed by GSI's probabilistic inference over policy compliance.
